name: command-pane
description: One-click buttons above the prompt, in folders the user customizes, with custom prompt buttons: a build-a-skill prompt, a handover to a new session whose button turns yellow and red as the context fills, a settings pane for technical level, approval detail, and recommended setup, and a Today pane of tasks and email per workspace

techLevel.title: Technical level
techLevel.description: How technical Claude's answers should be: nontechnical, some technical, or developer

approvalLevel.title: Approval detail
approvalLevel.description: How much detail Claude gives before asking for approval: auto, low, mid, or high

handoverWarn.title: Handover yellow at
handoverWarn.description: Context window fill (percent) at which the Handover button turns yellow

handoverAlert.title: Handover red at
handoverAlert.description: Context window fill (percent) at which the Handover button turns red
